info.title: Dukani API
info.description: Seller panel + platform admin. Money = integer Rials (UI shows Toman). Quantities = decimal in the item's base unit. Store-scoped routes: /api/v1/stores/{storeId}/…  Errors: RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with a stable `code`.

tags.name: Admin · Taxonomy
tags.description: Taxonomy: categories, product types (versioned schema), attributes, brands, units, store types (F30).

tags.name: Admin · Catalog
tags.description: Global catalog management (admin app, Figma 18–20: catalog, review, compare, merge).

tags.name: Admin · Seed
tags.description: Data entry batch: versioned catalog seed packages (4 store types) built from Excel.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Mobile + SMS OTP login only (auth, otp and their error frames).

tags.name: Customer addresses

post.summary: Sources become aliases of the target; store products are re-pointed; history untouched.
How many items/stores a schema change affects before publishing (never rewrites old items).
Upload catalog_seed_vX.Y.Z.json; runs validation and a dry-run diff.
Closes the current session.
Sends a 6-digit login code (AUTH-01). Invalid numbers never reach the SMS provider; errors: OTP_RATE_LIMITED, OTP_SEND_FAILED.
Verifies the code (AUTH-02); errors: OTP_WRONG, OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_RATE_LIMITED, USER_BLOCKED.
Rotates the refresh token; re-using an already rotated token closes that session (REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID).
